countries.reasoning: China is the leading producer of nucleotides according to industry reports from 2022-2023; production numbers are well-documented but some variability in reporting causes slightly reduced confidence.

Japan is a notable producer in the biotech sector; production data available from industrial reports, but less comprehensive than China or the US.
Germany has specialized production facilities; data is moderately complete, but exact figures have some uncertainty.
India's nucleotide production is growing; data from recent trade and production reports shows increasing output but with reporting gaps.
